title: "Swift as C++ Successor in FoundationDB" by Konrad Malawski (Strange Loop 2023)
summary: Konrad Malawski's Strange Loop 2023 talk shows how the FoundationDB team adopted Swift incrementally in a C++ codebase. It covers Swift's C++ interoperability, which let them move single functions or entire types over one at a time.
why: HN commenters recommend it as the main resource on Swift as an incremental successor to C++ and on how the interoperability works in practice.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The fairly recent presentation about starting to move FoundationDB to Swift[0] was also very interesting.
